heading: Working group
lead: For the purpose of carrying out section 2223a of this title, the Administrator shall establish a working group which shall, at a minimum, consist of—

tree.text: program officials from each of— who develop and disseminate hazardous materials identification and response data, and who collect, collate, analyze, and disseminate hazardous materials incident data;

children.text: the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration;
the Occupational Safety and Health Administration; and
the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives, Department of Justice,

tree.text: State and local operational officials with emergency response or relevant regulatory responsibilities; and
representatives of companies engaged in the manufacture and processing of chemicals.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was enacted as part of the Firefighters’ Safety Study Act, and not as part of the Federal Fire Prevention and Control Act of 1974 which comprises this chapter.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2002—Par. (1)(E). Pub. L. 107–296 substituted “the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives, Department of Justice,” for “the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, and Firearms,”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 2002 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 107–296 effective 60 days after Nov. 25, 2002, see section 4 of Pub. L. 107–296, set out as an Effective Date note under section 101 of Title 6, Domestic Security.
